blocking_findings.evidence: validate_panel_descriptor at scripts/trr0011_transfer.py:225-248 only checks that opaque_reservation.receipt_sha256 is truthy. The actual panel template value PENDING_AGENT2_RESERVATION therefore validates successfully.
blocking_findings.probe: validate_panel_descriptor(panel_descriptor_template_v1.json) returned paired_targets=true and the literal pending receipt.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Require a full lowercase 64-hex receipt SHA, non-pending reservation status, and an exact hash-bound reservation/selection descriptor before any target producer or panel is admitted.
blocking_findings.title: Pending opaque reservation is accepted as valid

blocking_findings.evidence: validate_variant_plan at scripts/trr0011_transfer.py:151-222 checks roles and layer ranges but does not require relative_parameter_l2, recipe_seed, fixed recipe, target resource/code hashes, or adaptation_binding. Removing the adapted target binding and changing its artificial delta strength still validates.
blocking_findings.probe: An in-memory plan with early relative_parameter_l2 changed from 0.001 to 0.5 and recipe_seed removed validated; an in-memory adapted row with adaptation_binding removed also validated.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Require explicit fixed recipe, layer, seed, and relative norm for each artificial arm; require hash-bound target/config/code provenance. Keep public_lora_2601 unavailable or label it historical comparator until independent source/selection/calibration disjointness is proven; it must not be called independently adapted by declaration alone.
blocking_findings.title: Artificial perturbation and adapted-target bindings are underconstrained

blocking_findings.evidence: _flatten_features accepts [records, positions, hidden] and summarize_transfer flattens each input independently before checking only total row count (scripts/trr0011_transfer.py:74-84 and 274-290).
blocking_findings.probe: clean_activation [2,2,2] and changed_activation [1,4,2] were accepted as four paired rows.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Require equal original rank and exact [records, positions] geometry for clean/changed H and projected features, or carry an explicit immutable row/position index digest through the caller.
blocking_findings.title: Flattening can silently change record/position pairing

blocking_findings.evidence: summarize_transfer accepts arbitrary clean_feature/changed_feature values and computes the normalized tied-E hyperplane formula without checking that features are the actual post-decoder normalized projected_hidden output. The deployed decoder applies W/b and any positionwise residual path before F.normalize; the helper has no state/loader binding or unit-norm check.
blocking_findings.probe: Non-unit feature rows were accepted and returned COMPUTED.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Bind the exact selected loader/state/readout/code identities and either compute effective projected features through that loader or verify unit norm and the logit equation for every supplied row. Do not substitute raw H or a manually normalized H that bypasses gain/bias/residual parameters.
blocking_findings.title: Effective decoder normalization and gain/bias path are not enforced

blocking_findings.evidence: The helper accepts clean_top_logits, clean_runner_logits, and readout_pairs independently; it does not verify that the runner is the true second-best class or that the supplied logits equal exp(s) times the supplied readout dot products. Any small positive margin is marked valid (scripts/trr0011_transfer.py:291-315).
blocking_findings.probe: A 1e-12 positive margin was reported valid_margin_rows=1 and COMPUTED hyperplane distance 7.07e-13 with no near-zero/conditioning flag.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Require top/runner IDs and a rank/equation consistency receipt from the full-vocabulary scorer, and predeclare a near-zero margin tolerance that reports the ratio as UNKNOWN/ill-conditioned rather than a stable explanatory statistic. Preserve the exact 1e-3 and 1e-2 perturbation strengths as separate predeclared arms if both are retained.
blocking_findings.title: Margin geometry lacks nearest-runner and conditioning checks

blocking_findings.evidence: validate_predictor_split accepts arbitrary nonempty string sets and returns threshold_fit_allowed=true (scripts/trr0011_transfer.py:409-428). It does not bind the family IDs to the variant plan, source reservation, or target update receipts.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Supply a hash-bound update-family manifest, require every development/held-out ID to be declared exactly once, and verify source/target recipe disjointness before any threshold fitting. Keep the module’s no-threshold behavior explicit.
blocking_findings.title: Held-out family validator is not tied to declared update families

blocking_findings.evidence: design_v1 proposes running A1+A2 on the new 32-per-domain subset, while the amendment assigns Agent2 the genuine frozen-model confirmation including the prospective A1+A2 common subset.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Remove the duplicate execution from the transfer run or consume one immutable Agent2-produced comparator artifact with an explicit shared denominator; do not run a second A1+A2 evaluation under a separate panel/decision path.
blocking_findings.title: A1+A2 transfer comparator duplicates Agent2 confirmation ownership

positive_checks: After-cut null requires exact activation equality and, when supplied, exact prediction equality.
Truth-dependent paired error inventory is marked non-deployable and separate from truth-free transfer summaries.
Synthetic suite passed all 8 current tests on CPU.
recommendation: Do not launch target capture or a transfer matrix until T1-T7 are resolved in the shared contract and the source/target/resource bindings are revalidated. The current module is a useful geometry prototype, not an execution-ready scorer.
